case_title: The State of Haryana v. Anand Kindo & Anr. Etc.
aggravating_circumstances: Pre-planned murder for greed, brutal manner, trust breach, attempt to escape
mitigating_circumstances: Age of accused, possibility of reformation
neutral_facts: The accused, who were trusted employees of an aged couple, murdered the couple while they were sleeping. The victims were elderly and the accused were paid to look after them. The crime was pre-planned and committed with brutality, using a hammer and tava to disfigure the victims beyond recognition. The accused were apprehended after attempting to escape from custody. The trial court initially imposed a death sentence, but the high court overturned this and sentenced the accused to life imprisonment. The supreme court reviewed the case and ultimately imposed a fixed term sentence of 30 years, balancing the need for justice with the possibility of rehabilitation.
